snippet.title: Them's Fightin' Herds - Console Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
Them’s Fightin’ Herds is available now on PlayStation 4 & 5, Xbox One & Series X|S, Nintendo Switch, and Steam!

Wallpapers for the new splash art can be found in our public art kit: https://drive.google.com/drive/u/0/folders/1Zlod6nmqoQUKn8atPyzIaozVieYxPLwn
